mapper.select: SELECT genre_id AS genreId, genre_title AS title FROM genre

SELECT p.performance_id AS performanceId, p.performance_title AS title, p.genre_id AS genreId, p.performance_date AS date, p.performance_img AS img FROM performance p WHERE p.genre_id = #{genreId} AND p.performance_deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status_id IN (1,2) ORDER BY p.performance_look_count DESC, p.performance_start_date ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT p.performance_id AS performanceId, p.performance_title AS title, p.performance_date AS date, p.performance_img AS img FROM performance p WHERE p.performance_deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status_id IN (1,2) ORDER BY p.performance_look_count DESC, p.performance_start_date ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT p.performance_id AS performanceId, p.performance_title AS title, p.performance_img AS img, p.performance_date AS date, s.status_description AS statusDescription, p.performance_runtime AS runtime, p.performance_price AS price, h.hall_address AS hallAddress, m.host_biz_name AS hostBizName, p.performance_start_date AS startDate, p.performance_end_date AS endDate FROM performance p JOIN status s ON p.status_id = s.status_id JOIN hall h ON p.hall_id = h.hall_id JOIN member m ON p.member_id = m.member_id WHERE p.performance_id = #{performanceId} AND p.performance_deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE performance SET performance_look_count = performance_look_count + 1 WHERE performance_id = #{performanceId} AND performance_deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT p.performance_id AS performanceId, p.performance_title AS title, p.performance_date AS date, p.performance_img AS img FROM performance p WHERE p.performance_start_date > #{now} AND p.performance_deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status_id IN (1,2) ORDER BY p.performance_start_date ASC, p.performance_date ASC LIMIT 4

SELECT p.performance_id AS performanceId, p.performance_title AS title, p.performance_date AS date, p.performance_img AS img FROM performance p WHERE p.performance_deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status_id IN (1, 2) AND p.performance_date >= current_date AND p.performance_date < current_date + interval '12 months'
AND immutable_unaccent(lower(p.performance_title)) LIKE '%' || immutable_unaccent(lower(#{kw})) || '%'
AND p.performance_title_vector @@ to_tsquery('simple', unaccent(lower(#{tsquery})))
AND ( p.performance_date > #{cursorDate} OR (p.performance_date = #{cursorDate} AND p.performance_id > #{cursorId}) )
ORDER BY p.performance_date ASC, p.performance_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM performance p WHERE p.performance_deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status_id IN (1, 2) AND p.performance_date >= current_date AND p.performance_date < current_date + interval '12 months'
AND immutable_unaccent(lower(p.performance_title)) LIKE '%' || immutable_unaccent(lower(#{kw})) || '%'
AND p.performance_title_vector @@ to_tsquery('simple', unaccent(lower(#{tsquery})))
LIMIT 3001 ) AS limited

SELECT p.performance_id AS performanceId, p.performance_title AS title, p.performance_date AS date, p.performance_img AS img FROM performance p WHERE p.genre_id = #{genreId} AND p.performance_id != #{performanceId} AND p.performance_deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status_id IN (1,2) ORDER BY p.performance_look_count DESC, p.performance_date ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT p.performance_id AS performanceId, p.performance_title AS title, p.performance_date AS date, p.performance_img AS img, s.status_description AS statusDescription, p.performance_look_count AS lookCount, p.performance_created_at AS createdDate, p.performance_deleted_at AS deletedDate FROM performance p JOIN status s ON p.status_id = s.status_id WHERE p.member_id = #{memberId} AND p.performance_deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.performance_created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM performance p WHERE p.member_id = #{memberId} AND p.performance_deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT p.performance_id AS performanceId, p.performance_title AS title, p.performance_img AS img, p.performance_date AS date, s.status_description AS statusDescription, pf.performance_favorite_created_at AS scrapCreatedAt FROM performance_favorite pf JOIN performance p ON pf.performance_id = p.performance_id JOIN status s ON p.status_id = s.status_id WHERE pf.member_id = #{memberId} AND s.status_code != 102 ORDER BY pf.performance_favorite_created_at DESC

SELECT p.performance_id AS id, m.member_id AS hostId, h.hall_id AS hallId, g.genre_id AS genreId, s.status_id AS statusId, p.performance_title AS title, p.performance_price AS price, p.performance_date AS performanceDateAndTime, p.performance_runtime AS runtime, p.performance_img AS thumbnailUrl, p.performance_start_date AS startDate, p.performance_end_date AS endDate, p.performance_is_event AS isEvent, p.performance_look_count AS lookCount, p.performance_created_at AS createdAt, p.performance_updated_at AS updatedAt, p.performance_deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM performance p JOIN reservation r ON p.performance_id = r.performance_id JOIN hall h ON p.hall_id = h.hall_id JOIN genre g ON p.genre_id = g.genre_id JOIN status s ON p.status_id = s.status_id JOIN member m ON p.member_id = m.member_id WHERE r.reservation_id = #{reservationId}

SELECT p.performance_id AS id, m.member_id AS hostId, h.hall_id AS hallId, g.genre_id AS genreId, s.status_id AS statusId, p.performance_title AS title, p.performance_price AS price, p.performance_date AS performanceDateAndTime, p.performance_runtime AS runtime, p.performance_img AS thumbnailUrl, p.performance_start_date AS startDate, p.performance_end_date AS endDate, p.performance_is_event AS isEvent, p.performance_look_count AS lookCount, p.performance_created_at AS createdAt, p.performance_updated_at AS updatedAt, p.performance_deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM performance p JOIN hall h ON p.hall_id = h.hall_id JOIN genre g ON p.genre_id = g.genre_id JOIN status s ON p.status_id = s.status_id JOIN member m ON p.member_id = m.member_id WHERE p.performance_id = #{id}
